description: DESTRUCTIVE: Execute an arbitrary shell command on the LOCAL machine where the JRD desktop app runs. This can read, modify, or delete any file the user can; install software; or alter system state. The command runs with the privileges of the JRD desktop process. Treat with extreme caution — only invoke when explicitly asked, and always show the user the exact command first. Output is captured (stdout + stderr) and capped at 64 KB per stream. The child is killed (SIGTERM, then SIGKILL) on timeout.

command.description: The shell command (or argv string when shell=false) to execute.

cwd.description: Optional working directory to run the command in.

env.description: Optional extra environment variables merged into the child env.

shell.description: Run via the system shell so pipes/redirects/glob work (default true). Set false for argv-style.

timeout_ms.description: Kill the child after this many ms (default 30000, max 300000).

name: jrd_execute_shell
